diagnostic.notSaved: This result could not be saved locally.

adminSession.password: The login was an administrator session. The password you saved gives administrator rights, and Guardian takes only a guest password, so it was removed from this phone. Only read requests were sent.
adminSession.acl: The login was an administrator session. The node granted administrator rights to this companion from its own access list, with no password. Guardian sent only read requests.
adminSession.unknown: The login was an administrator session. Guardian sent only read requests.

outcome.COMPANION_NO_ACK: Transport error: the companion did not confirm the request
outcome.CAPABILITY_MISSING: Not supported by the companion firmware

ALL_CHECKS_REPLIED.explanation: The node answered every check that was sent.

PARTIAL_REPLY.explanation: The node answered at least one check. Others did not get a reply.
PARTIAL_REPLY.causesNote: Possible causes. None of them is confirmed.

causes.route: The path to the node is marginal, so some replies were lost.
causes.congestion: The channel was busy while the later check was sent.

nextSteps.retry: Run the diagnostic again later to see whether the missing check answers.

limitations.unanswered: Some checks got no reply, so their data is missing.

LOGIN_REJECTED.explanation: The node answered and rejected the guest login. Status and telemetry were not requested.

causes.password: The guest password is not the one the node expects.
causes.permissions: The node does not allow guest access.

nextSteps.credentials: Check the guest password set on the node.
nextSteps.other: A node that accepts guest access can be tested without a password.

limitations.noSession: Without a session, no status or telemetry was read.

NO_REPLY.explanation: The companion sent the request, but no reply came back within the wait time. This does not tell whether the node is working.
NO_REPLY.causesNote: Possible causes. None of them is confirmed.

causes.route: No usable radio path to the node right now.
causes.congestion: The channel was busy or the reply was lost on the way.
causes.device: The node itself did not handle the request.

nextSteps.wait: Wait a few minutes and run the diagnostic again.
nextSteps.closer: Move the companion closer to the node or to a repeater on the path.

limitations.unknownCause: A missing reply cannot be told apart from a lost one.

NOT_CONNECTED.explanation: No companion was connected, so nothing was sent.

nextSteps.connect: Connect a companion, then run the diagnostic again.

LINK_LOST.explanation: The Bluetooth link to the companion was lost during the run.
LINK_LOST.causesNote: Possible causes. None of them is confirmed.

causes.range: The phone moved out of Bluetooth range.
causes.companion: The companion restarted or switched Bluetooth off.

nextSteps.reconnect: Reconnect to the companion, then run the diagnostic again.

limitations.notSent: Requests after the loss were not sent.

COMPANION_NO_ACK.explanation: The companion did not confirm the request, so it may never have been sent.
COMPANION_NO_ACK.causesNote: Possible causes. None of them is confirmed.

causes.companion: The companion is busy or in a bad state.

nextSteps.reconnect: Reconnect to the companion, then run the diagnostic again.

limitations.notSent: The request may not have reached the radio.

CAPABILITY_MISSING.explanation: The companion firmware does not support the status request.

limitations.firmware: Checks the firmware lacks were not sent.

COMMAND_REJECTED.causesNote: Possible causes. None of them is confirmed.

causes.firmware: The firmware does not handle this request.
causes.contact: The node is not in the companion's contacts.

MALFORMED_RESPONSE.explanation: A reply arrived but could not be read.
MALFORMED_RESPONSE.causesNote: Possible causes. None of them is confirmed.

causes.firmware: The firmware sends a format this app does not know.
causes.corrupt: The reply was damaged on the way.

nextSteps.report: If it repeats, report the firmware version and the raw bytes shown below.

limitations.unreadable: The reply is shown as raw bytes only.

CANCELLED.explanation: You cancelled the check. No further requests were sent.

nextSteps.again: Run the diagnostic again when ready.

UNEXPECTED_ERROR.summary: The check could not be completed
UNEXPECTED_ERROR.explanation: Something unexpected stopped the run. No conclusion about the node can be drawn.

limitations.unknown: The cause of the failure is not known.

unknown.explanation: This run has a result the app does not know.
